data.gender_notes: Dilruba is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'dil' meaning 'heart' and 'ruba' meaning 'delight' or 'joy'. In Islamic tradition, Dilruba signifies the joy and happiness one experiences when their heart is connected to Allah. The name Dilruba carries the meaning “Delight of the heart” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dilruba usually hope their child will grow to embody delight of the heart and live with faith, good character and purpose.
